story: CAD Sketcher, free and open-source project bringing CAD like tools to Blender3d
text: Nick Kallen has been working on an BREP based CAD tool with the sort of ease of modeling that things like Blender has. Originally it was based on C3D, but he switched halfway through to Parasolid.[0] It’s amazing the amount of features he has built considering it’s a one person project. It’s worth going through his progress report videos.[1] [0] [VIDEO] [1] [LINK]

story: Show HN: Chili3d – A open-source, browser-based 3D CAD application
